T: Burgers, costumes and a grudge match.
D: A shy fast food cashier follows an awkward gamer back to his hometown for his long-planned revenge.
P: Serve the mains at the dress-as-your-favourite-animal party.
S: Eagle and shark costume party cheerios
the animal costume party where it all starts

Little red cocktail sausages simmered for 5 minutes and served hot on toothpicks with a bowl of tomato sauce for dipping. Bring a pot of water to a simmer, add 500g cocktail frankfurts and heat for 5 minutes without boiling so the skins don't split. Drain, pile into a bowl with toothpicks and serve with 125ml tomato sauce for dipping.
the dip at every New Zealand party
Reduced cream stirred with French onion soup mix and a squeeze of lemon, chilled until thick, salted potato chips for dipping.
Kiwi mince and cheese pie bites
a feed from the hometown bakery when Lily visits Jarrod's family

Peppery beef mince in rich gravy with a slice of tasty cheese, baked in little shortcrust cases under flaky puff lids, tomato sauce for dunking. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 300ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and pepper, and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with mince, top each with a square of tasty cheese (6 slices), then a puff pastry round from 1 sheet. Brush with egg and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
M: Lily's job at the burger counter
Beef patties with cheese, beetroot, lettuce, tomato and tomato sauce on toasted buns, the Kiwi takeaway way.
takeaways wrapped in paper, the Kiwi way

Fresh white fish in a crisp beer batter with thick-cut double-fried chips, wrapped in paper with lemon, tartare sauce and tomato sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak 20 minutes and dry. Fry at 150C for 6 minutes, drain. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Heat the oil to 180C, fry the chips again 3 minutes until golden and keep warm. Dip 4 hake or gurnard fillets in flour, then batter, and fry 5 to 6 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped pickles and capers for tartare. Wrap in paper with lemon.
W: Cocoa biscuits crunchy with cornflakes, topped with chocolate icing and a walnut half, baked at 180C for 15 minutes.
K: Fight Man rematch lemon, lime and bitters
Lily taking Jarrod on at his favourite video game

Lime cordial and a few dashes of bitters topped with lemonade until it turns pink. Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 30ml lime cordial and 4 dashes aromatic bitters to each, top with 200ml lemonade and stir until it turns pink. Garnish with lemon and lime wedges.

s.how: Stir 1 packet French onion soup mix into 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp lemon juice. Chill for at least 1 hour until thick, stirring once. Serve in a bowl surrounded by 200g salted potato chips for dipping.

m.note: Lily's job at the burger counter
m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and fry 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of tasty cheese at the end. Toast 4 buns and build with lettuce, tomato, 4 slices tinned beetroot, the patty and tomato sauce.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 75g sugar, then mix in 175g flour, 25g cocoa and 50g cornflakes. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Cool, ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cocoa and water, and top each with a walnut half.
